notes.title: Summer? Vacation? No, you haven't.
notes.content:
We continue to put gloss and shine on the "Administrators" and prepare it for a full-fledged release:
- another swarm of bugs has been mercilessly caught
- improved the overall stability of the build - now the game does not crash at the most crucial moment
- the interface has not undergone a cardinal, but tangible refinement - the answer options are now designed in the form of full-fledged buttons. 
No more squinting your eyes and aiming the mouse at small letters. From now on, the game has hefty buttons!

notes.title: Update 2.0
notes.content:
Added achievements, at the moment it is 100% of all planned.
Improved interface, all locations are available.

notes.title: Wake up soon, we have an update here!
notes.content:
[b]We, like the heroes of our game, did not sleep for several nights in a row and prepared an epic update. I can't wait to tell you![/b]

Firstly, there is a lot of new content in the game. That is, all of it. Everything we have. Here it is right now already here. Rather, download, play, read - the whole story of two idlers in an old Hotel is now fully available!

Secondly, we have added achievements to the game! Now you can officially pass the "Administrators" 100%! Yes, I know it's important to you. And thanks to the achievements, you won't miss a single gram of content.

Thirdly, we have updated all the animations and now, in the most dramatic places, the story takes on a truly cinematic gloss.

[h2]And for dessert - music! Tracks - from jazz to dark ambient now set the tone, atmosphere, and just decorate the story.[/h2]

Poof! Like everything. I hope you like it!
Write if anything!
